Why am I seeing this survey?
If you see an Ad from
, you have been selected to participate in a survey. If you do not want to participate in the survey, simply don’t respond to any of the survey questions.
>x< or a third party partner tabulates and analyzes the results for any brands that participate in the survey. These results reflect the combined responses of those who participated in the survey.

Why are these surveys being conducted?
These surveys are intended to help >x< and other companies understand how users perceive and interact with products and services. This is a standard industry practice across many digital platforms.
